post1.quote: If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, governments will be unable to control what it does.

post2.quote: Superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will be beyond government control.

post3.quote: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, governments will be unable to control its actions.

paragraph.quote: We must reckon with the possibility that a system far more capable than its creators will act beyond the reach of the institutions meant to govern it.
